theme: Light theme with deep navy dark sections. Ensures a premium, Apple/Stripe-inspired trust-centric aesthetic.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border border-white/40' for sticky navbar and floating elements.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Use soft, diffuse ambient shadows: 'shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]' for standard cards, and 'shadow-[0_20px_40px_rgb(0,0,0,0.08)]' for hover states.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use subtle 1px borders 'border-slate-200' or 'border-white/40' to define edges crisply without muddying the design.
visual_enhancers.radii: Use 'rounded-2xl' for large cards, 'rounded-xl' for inner elements or inputs, 'rounded-full' for pills and icon wrappers.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-lg. Primary: 'bg-blue-700 hover:bg-blue-800 text-white shadow-md transition-all active:scale-95'. Secondary: 'bg-white text-slate-900 border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50'.
components.inputs: Customized Shadcn inputs. Use 'h-12 rounded-xl border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 focus:border-blue-500 transition-all'.
components.cards: Premium service cards: 'bg-white rounded-2xl p-8 border border-slate-100 shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] hover:shadow-[0_20px_40px_rgb(0,0,0,0.08)] hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300'.
components.stepper: Clean horizontal progress indicator for wizard. Use active blue states with checkmarks for completed steps.
components.file_upload: Dashed border area 'border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300 rounded-2xl p-10 hover:border-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-50 transition-colors flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-slate-500'.

grids.bento_marketing: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-8 for the 3 premium service cards. Ensure equal height stretching 'h-full'.
grids.dashboard_stats: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 for admin overview metrics.
grids.dashboard_layout: CSS Grid with 250px sidebar and 1fr main content area.

layouts.hero: 12-column grid. Left 7 columns for typography and CTAs. Right 5 columns for the React Three Fiber canvas. Generous padding 'py-24 md:py-32'.
layouts.section_spacing: Use 'py-24' for main marketing sections to allow the design to breathe.
layouts.dark_section: Footer and specific trust banner should use Deep Navy ('bg-[#020617]') with white/slate-300 text. Add subtle noise texture if possible.
layouts.wizard_layout: Max-w-3xl mx-auto for the application wizard form. Keep it focused and central.

motion.hover_states: All interactive elements must lift slightly ('-translate-y-0.5' or '-translate-y-1') and adjust shadow.
motion.page_transitions: Use framer-motion for smooth fade-up ('initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}') on section entry.
motion.micro_interactions: Accordions, dropdowns, and tabs must have smooth height/opacity transitions. Button clicks should have a slight 'scale-95' effect.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text against soft backgrounds meets APCA guidelines. Use slate-600 for body text, not lighter.
accessibility.focus: All inputs and buttons must have visible focus rings ('focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-blue-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2').
accessibility.testing_ids: All interactive elements MUST include 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., 'data-testid="apply-now-btn"').

media.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for clean, premium UI icons.
media.illustrations: Rely primarily on the 3D scene and high-quality UI mockups over generic illustrations.

3d_libraries.implementation: Create a premium 3D hero scene featuring abstract floating documents, a shield, and subtle checkmarks. Use 'MeshPhysicalMaterial' with 'transmission: 0.5', 'roughness: 0.2', 'thickness: 2' for a premium frosted glass/plastic aesthetic. Use 'Float' from drei for gentle organic movement. Illuminate with 'Environment' (preset='city') and soft directional lights to create elegant reflections.

image_urls.description: Professional person using laptop, suitable for the 'Contact' or 'How it Works' section to convey human trust.
Abstract blue geometric shape, useful as a subtle background element or fallback if 3D context fails.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard HTML structure but stylize with pure Tailwind CSS for marketing pages to ensure complete layout freedom. Use Shadcn strictly for interactive UI components.
For the 3D Hero Scene, ensure the canvas is responsive and does not block scroll events. Use 'pointer-events-none' on the canvas wrapper if it overlays text.
The 3 service cards (Scholarship, PAN Card, Learner's Licence) must be prominent and identical in structure, emphasizing the flat ₹250 fee.
Implement the wizard form with a clear 6-step progress indicator at the top. Handle state management carefully between steps.
Ensure the Admin dashboard uses a high-density 'dashboard_stats' layout, contrasting the airy, generous spacing of the marketing site.
Never use generic placeholder images (via.placeholder.com). If needed, use the provided Unsplash URLs or high-quality Lucide icons.
In the footer, explicitly include the legal disclaimer text prominently, as it is a critical business requirement.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component are located in `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx`.
